[package]
name = "kvhttp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.105"
axum = "0.8.9"
tokio = { version = "1.54.1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "net"] }

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
strip = "symbols"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/kvhttp ./app
